'''Muriel Corwin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]] her brother [[Corwin]], the "Durasteel Duke", unexpectedly died, and [[Vala Organa]] convinced Muriel to impersonate her brother using a holographic disguise to prevent a blow to the morale of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]]. However, a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] participant of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] confronted Muriel, forcing her to reveal her true identity and the death of her brother, which by then happened over a month ago.
